tool_args.rationale: The five observations vary only u_now, leaving the role of the gradient and the before–after bridge dynamics unidentified. The open-branch probe can distinguish those mechanisms before committing to a model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The saturating pilot curve is compatible with recruitment, but all other inputs are fixed, so it cannot distinguish recruitment from the mobility bridge.
The immediate ambiguity is between open mechanism branches, for which the discriminating probe is more targeted and less costly.
It is irrelevant to the mechanism ambiguity.
